title: OES-32 HLS Prototype: Profile A sidecar (C++ HLS + g++ testbench)
description:
Profile A sidecar to oes32-residual: a C++14 High-Level Synthesis (HLS) research prototype of OES-32 telemetry-triage checks (coherence floor, EVEN/ODD symmetry, FOLD8 ring balance) on a 32-element vector, behind an AXI4-Lite interface declaration, with a portable g++ testbench (6 test cases, 8 checks) that runs in CI without AMD/Xilinx tools. A Vitis HLS script targets the AMD Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC ZCU111 board as a TARGET.

Relationship to ADR-001. The normative residual R lives in oes32-residual@b77b612. The checks here differ in two documented ways: a squared difference compared to τ = 0.09 (equivalent to an absolute threshold of 0.3), and a ≥ fail rule (the normative contract fails only when R > tolerance).

Evidence tags. C++ testbench: SYNTHETIC inputs, runs in CI. Vitis HLS synthesis: UNRUN (the CI synthesis job is a placeholder that only echoes the command). Latency < 20 ns, 100 MHz clock, II = 1: TARGET (design intent, no synthesis or timing report exists). Board deployment on ZCU111: UNRUN. Kuramoto example output: SYNTHETIC.

Scope and limits. Research prototype. Not synthesized, placed, routed, or run on an FPGA; not a QPU, quantum device, or quantum-hardware result; not production, certified, medical, or field hardware; not the normative OES-32 residual.

Evidence tags follow sparkainlp-x/.github (SYNTHETIC / REPORTED / TARGET / UNRUN).
